types.name: Arithmetic mean, weighted, combined and corrected
types.description: Asks for the mean of a list or table, a weighted or combined mean, a corrected mean after a wrong entry, or a property of the mean.

types.name: Geometric and harmonic means
types.description: Asks for a geometric or harmonic mean, average speed or rate, or uses AM ≥ GM ≥ HM or GM² = AM × HM.

types.name: Median and mode of raw data
types.description: Gives a list or a discrete frequency table and asks for the median or the mode.

types.name: Mean, median and mode of grouped data
types.description: Gives a continuous frequency table (classes and frequencies) and asks for the mean, median or mode.

types.name: Mean, median and mode relation
types.description: Gives two of mean, median and mode for a moderately skewed distribution and asks for the third, or asks their order in a skewed distribution.

types.name: Quartiles, deciles and percentiles
types.description: Asks for a quartile, decile or percentile of a list or table, or their relation to the median.
